prompt: Your company offers an early-retirement package. It would give you time now, but you'd need to make your savings last and decide what work has meant to you.

leftCard.label: Retire
leftCard.outcome: You wake up on a Monday with nowhere to be. It takes some getting used to.

rightCard.label: Keep working
rightCard.outcome: The money keeps coming in. You keep thinking about what you'd do with the time.

prompt: A routine health-screening invitation arrives. You feel well, but screening can bring reassurance, follow-up tests, or uncertainty you hadn't planned for.

leftCard.label: Book it
leftCard.outcome: They catch something early. The nurse says you were lucky.

prompt: Your family asks you to look after the grandchildren every Wednesday. They rely on you, and you love them, but the commitment would reshape your own week.

leftCard.label: Of course
leftCard.outcome: Wednesdays become the best and most exhausting day of the week.

rightCard.label: I need my time
rightCard.outcome: You get your Wednesdays back. The house is very quiet.

prompt: You can finally afford the motorbike you've wanted for years. The cost is manageable, but you'd be taking on a new risk and using savings you could keep for later.

leftCard.label: Buy it
leftCard.outcome: You ride along the coast at sunrise. Your knees hate you.

rightCard.label: Too old for that
rightCard.outcome: You still look them up online now and then.

prompt: Your school reunion is coming up. You wonder who you'll be glad to see—and whether returning to that room will feel like reconnecting or revisiting old roles.

leftCard.label: Go
leftCard.outcome: Everyone's older. Everyone's exactly the same.

rightCard.label: Skip it
rightCard.outcome: You see the photos later. Mr. Henderson's house is still there.

prompt: The children have moved out. The house is expensive to maintain and full of memories; a smaller place could free resources, but leaving would make that change feel real.

leftCard.label: Downsize
leftCard.outcome: A smaller place and a bigger bank balance. You miss the garden.

rightCard.label: Stay
rightCard.outcome: Every room is full of memories, and dust.

prompt: A grandchild offers to set up video calls so you can keep in touch from a distance. It could bring you closer, though learning another device feels like work.

leftCard.label: Learn
leftCard.outcome: You spend the first call looking at your own forehead. Then you get it.

rightCard.label: Too fiddly
rightCard.outcome: You stick to phone calls. They ring less often.

prompt: A pottery class is starting at the community centre. You could try something unfamiliar and meet people, or keep the quiet Tuesday routine you've grown used to.

leftCard.label: Join
leftCard.outcome: Your first bowl is wonky. Your friends there are not.

prompt: You could use a substantial part of your savings for a long trip. The chance may not come again in the same way, but neither will the security that money provides.

leftCard.label: Go
leftCard.outcome: Temples, deserts, and a sunburn you'll talk about forever.

rightCard.label: Save it
rightCard.outcome: The money's safe. The brochures stay on the coffee table.
